problems.title: Two Sum
problems.description: Given an integer array and a target, return the indices of two distinct elements whose values add to the target. Exactly one pair is valid; return the indices in either order.
problems.constraints:
2 <= nums.length <= 10^4
-10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9
-10^9 <= target <= 10^9
Exactly one valid answer exists.

difficultyProvenance.reason: LeetCode labels the canonical Two Sum problem Easy.

python.timeComplexityReason: The nested loops inspect each distinct pair at most once.
python.spaceComplexityReason: The search uses a fixed number of index variables and returns two indices.

java.spaceComplexityReason: The search uses a fixed number of index variables and returns two indices.

cpp.timeComplexityReason: The nested loops inspect each distinct pair at most once.
cpp.spaceComplexityReason: The search uses a fixed number of index variables and returns two indices.

python.timeComplexityReason: Each element is checked once, with average constant-time hash map lookup and insertion.
python.spaceComplexityReason: In the worst case the map stores all previously visited values.

problems.title: Valid Palindrome
problems.description: Treat uppercase and lowercase letters as equal and ignore every non-letter and non-digit. Return whether the remaining sequence reads the same in both directions.
problems.constraints:
1 <= s.length <= 2 * 10^5
s contains printable ASCII characters.

python.timeComplexityReason: The two pointers move inward and each character is examined at most once.
python.spaceComplexityReason: The algorithm uses only two index variables.

problems.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problems.description: Given a string, return the length of its longest contiguous substring that contains no repeated character.
problems.constraints:
0 <= s.length <= 10^5
s contains English letters, digits, symbols, and spaces.

difficultyProvenance.reason: LeetCode labels Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters Medium.

python.timeComplexityReason: There are O(n^2) start/end pairs and each set membership operation is average O(1).
python.spaceComplexityReason: The set for one candidate substring holds at most n distinct characters.
